fallback.unknown: absent or inconsistent state evidence; missing context metadata

full_model_parity.denominator: complete comparable requests including known fallback
full_model_parity.numerator: raw and model parity plus required semantic identity, release, preprocessing and publication provenance; base also requires trace-to-log match

lineage.excluded: known incompatible context or invalid available publication provenance
lineage.numerator: compatible complete semantic/input/implementation context and no known invalid served publication provenance
lineage.scope: Incident summary; complete value metadata is independently required by the action gate

missing.unknown: absent or inconsistent state evidence; missing context metadata

model_parity.denominator: requests with comparable model input including known fallback
model_parity.numerator: model input exactly equals identity-preprocessed eligible policy value

raw_parity.denominator: requests with comparable observed raw value
raw_parity.excluded: known raw absence; incompatible incident contexts/provenance
raw_parity.numerator: raw value exactly equals eligible policy value in compatible context

partition: denominator + excluded + unknown = declared requests; a zero denominator has null rate

publication_timing.age: request time minus served publication time
publication_timing.eligibility: verified served publication provenance and compatible contracts; known absent publication excluded, uncertain identity unknown
publication_timing.lag: latest eligible policy publication time minus served publication time
publication_timing.lag_is_not: elapsed update waiting time or measured propagation latency

scope: Pedagogical exact integer metrics; separate six-request base and four-request change cohorts.
unknown_policy: Never count missing telemetry or metadata as a match. Show coverage with every rate.
